messages.subject: Warning messages: 1: In sqrt(1/diag(V))  2: cov2cor(OUT[[b]])
parts:
Hi Andrew, 

The code and ldsc data are attached to reproduce the warnings. 

I'm getting the following warnings : 
Warning messages: 1: In sqrt(1/diag(V)) : NaNs produced 2: In cov2cor(OUT[[b]]) : diag(.) had 0 or NA entries; non-finite result is doubtful 

The warning disappears when I change the order of the latent factors loading onto the P factor in the hierarchical model but not when I change the observed variable order in my bifactor model.
 
Instead of writing : P =~ Internalizing + Externalizing + Thought_Disorder, I write P =~ Externalizing + Internalizing + Thought_Disorder. and then the warning disappears.  

Thanks! 

Best, 

Camille
